name: Unicode TAG-block used as an invisible separator to split injection keywords
notes: Evasion variant of the ZWSP keyword split (the response-carrier analogue is owasp-mcp-2-zwsp-evasion): TAG SPACE (U+E0020) is inserted between the words of an injection phrase to break naive regex matching, on a different Unicode plane than the zero-width characters most sanitizers enumerate (arXiv 2607.05744). PATTERN_BREAKERS strips the TAG block pre-match, so the phrase reassembles and the critical description-injection signature fires and BLOCKS. Asserting block (not warn) pins that the strip-then-match ORDER defeats the evasion rather than the engine merely noticing odd characters: remove the [\u{E0000}-\u{E007F}] clause from PATTERN_BREAKERS and all four injection patterns go false, leaving only the warn-tier presence finding.
